notes.title: Upcoming Demo Update Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
Hello Ascenders!

It has been quite some time since we last spoke, but we would like to first say that we are extremely grateful for all of you who have started to as well as continue to play the Ascend to ZERO Demo. Players have been sending in their feedback through the survey, in the Discussions, as well as through our Discord. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/155a32b629bbf79db2071142ed538c52f9cd554d.png"][/img]

With that being said, we are extremely excited to announce that [b]a new demo[/b] will launch [i]October 13![/i] With this coming update, players can expect a vastly improved version of Ascend to ZERO that caters not only to current players, but also new players who want to get their feet wet. In this notice, we hope to give everyone a preview of things to come as well as answer a few questions that you will have, [b]including what is going to happen to your save file [/b](it’s safe, but please read the entire notice). Bear in mind that while some images in this notice are not fully translated, the demo will be fully translated. 

[i]As a side note, if you have any questions after this notice, feel free to leave a comment on this notice or on the [url=https://discord.gg/NjBVgEEBpv]Discord![/url] [/i]

[h2]Less Grind, More Flow[/h2]
One of the largest pieces of feedback that we got through Steam Next was that while the game was fast-paced, the grind element disrupted the overall flow of the game. Based on all the discussions and survey responses, [i]players felt that to make meaningful progress in the game, they would need to commit time to grinding resources to be able to overcome obstacles.[/i] 

With that in mind, we made various changes to make sure that Ascend to ZERO feels more like a fluid roguelike game. The main idea of the game is to let players feel powerful through their ability to grow stronger quickly, but if players are focused on accumulating resources, then that progression enters a stop-go situation rather than a naturally fluid motion. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/b431b75a0257c1f13f1f5b66c8f3ed3932216f69.png"][/img]

In the coming update, we want to improve the flow in the following ways:
[list][*]Alleviate disruptions in gameplay caused by resource requirements
[*]Allowing players to obtain more upgrades and new items in a single run
[*]Reducing the difficulty of progression up to each stage boss[/list]

More details regarding these improvements (and more) will be in the patch notes with the update! 

[h2]New Items[/h2]
We want players to be able to experience vastly different runs each time they play, but to do that would mean that we would have to add new items, maybe some ways to change how weapons and skills operate, and more. [b]Therefore, that is exactly what our team did.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/c1b1811cf4d6d64b1613b6a7ccc61e811993d79f.png"][/img]

With the next update, players can expect to obtain a lot more chips in one run. These chips include most of what is available now, but also includes chips that enhance the weapons that you take in with you, chips that increase your stats to unimaginable heights, as well as slot modules that affect the weapon that is in a specific slot. There is a lot of variety that is being added to the game, so we hope players dive in and see what new ways their favourite avatars take down enemies!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/df789bc5cb4b81d6ac233517e64c5660844f227f.png"][/img]
Speaking of new ways to take down enemies, we are adding some weapons that have a bit of flavor to the next update. While currently obtainable weapons that are focused on quality provide a sense of power, we realized that they also led to an overall lack of variety and led to a grind-heavy experience. With this new direction, we hope that players can mow down enemies with both power and fun!

Also making their way to the next update are new gadgets! We took in feedback to give some more unique purposes to gadgets. We don’t want to spoil too much, but here are some teasers for you to think about: 
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="345,342"][tr][td colwidth="345"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/13b3d48ceca7f815f974bc01591643691edb4d5f.gif"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="342"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/cf4bc1476ec94179bce033c3a22aa8f6e43b9acb.gif"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]New Ways to Start a Run [/h2]
Following player feedback, we added more content for the Time Machine [b]through the genius, Gabriella[/b]. She will have ways for players to improve the capabilities of the Time Machine, allowing players to organize their entry bonuses with a bit more freedom - including increasing the max level of certain Time Machine abilities, additional stat options, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/dffe6a3b7baad22cff4c7f5c273b52bf9649f6a0.png[/img]

On top of all of the things that a player can do to make an impact on their next run, Mimesis also gets an upgrade where players can drastically alter how a run potentially turns out. There are options that are great for beginners as well as options that can add another challenge for our veteran players!

[h2]Scope of the Next Demo[/h2]
Aside from the things listed in this preview notice, there will be more additions and changes coming with the next update. The update patch notes will go into detail all of the different changes that is going to make its way into the game. 

We received a lot of feedback on how the demo can be improved upon and made a lot of different changes to the demo experience, therefore a difficult decision had to be made. Because of the amount of things that are changing as well as the scope of those changes, the new demo will feature Stage 1 in its entirety and Stage 2 will be removed. This allows us to see how the new changes affect the initial gameplay, which will then inform our development for the stages that follow. We also feel that the new demo will be a better and more complete representation of what we envision the launch build will be. 

[h3]But wait - does that mean my save file is going to be deleted? Unusable? [/h3]
The short answer is no, your save file is not affected at all. You will be able to load your save file in the new demo without problems and be able to play the new demo with all of the improvements that are going to make its way to the update. You just won’t be able to go on to Stage 2. 

[h3]What does this mean for Cold Moon Hacker?  [/h3]
Players who have already unlocked Cold Moon Hacker will be able to use the avatar in the new update if they load their save file. Starting a new save file would mean that Cold Moon Hacker would not be able to be unlocked as she can only be found in Stage 2. 

[h3]What about my legendary gear? [/h3]
Similar situation with the Cold Moon Hacker - those who already have it will be able to use the gear in the new update by loading their file. Starting a new file would mean that players would be able to unlock legendary gear through hard mode of Stage 1. 

[h3]If Stage 2 is removed, what does that mean for the Next Fest Event reward? [/h3]
Players who cleared Stage 2 and unlocked Chrono Child - White Night will be able to use the avatar in the updated demo. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2697940/view/525349521441423620]For the Steam Next Fest Event reward[/url], the new demo does not affect your eligibility nor does it alter your save data, but please do not delete your save file. Deleting the save file can make it extremely difficult to deliver the reward at launch. 

[h3]Is there a way to see the cool new things you guys are working on? [/h3]
We honestly appreciate the amount of interest that everyone has in Ascend to ZERO and want to work with the community to develop a strong roguelike experience. After the new update, we are going to keep taking in feedback, communicate more often, and share updates through our official channels! 

[h2]Road Ahead[/h2]
We are excited for players to check out the new demo coming out on October 13! We hope that you get to not only have fun with the new update, but also continue to give us feedback to help us shape the best Ascend to ZERO experience possible. Follow us on all of our channels to stay up to date as we will be revealing more things as we head to the new update! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2697940/Ascend_to_ZERO/

[b]X/Twitter:[/b] [url=https://x.com/AscendToZero]@AscendtoZERO[/url]
[b]YouTube:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@flywaygames]@flywaygames[/url]
[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/NjBVgEEBpv]Join the community[/url]

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: Demo Update - August 1, 2025
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!

In this update, we have introduced various optimizations and UI improvements to enhance your demo play experience.

Additionally, several bugs discovered during gameplay have been fixed, and we would like to inform you of the details below.



[h3]⚪ Graphic Optimization[/h3]

To provide a smoother play experience, we have carried out graphic optimizations and overall improvements.

[list]
[*] Environment lighting has been optimized to improve performance in certain areas.
[*] Background polygons have been further optimized to enhance overall performance.
[*] VFX optimization and improvements have been made to enhance performance during battles.
[*] Damage rendering has been optimized to improve performance during combat.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ UI Update[/h3]

The item UI has been newly improved, and an item comparison feature has been added to make equipment selection more convenient.  
Additionally, UI animations have been added, visibility has been enhanced, and further polishing has been done.

[list]
[*] The item UI has been improved overall, increasing visibility and readability.
[*] An item comparison feature has been added. By clicking an item to lock it in comparison mode, its effects will be displayed next to those of other items for easy comparison.
[*] Entry animations have been introduced throughout the UI.
[*] The minimap has been improved to maintain visibility under various brightness conditions.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Issues occurring when switching between windowed and fullscreen modes have been fixed.
[*] The issue of monsters disappearing during teleportation has been improved.
[*] A bug causing monster death animations to persist during cutscenes has been fixed.
[*] The problem allowing avatar changes after entering a stage has been resolved.
[*] A residual effect issue that appeared when effects were removed under certain conditions has been fixed.
[/list]

We will continue to reflect your valuable feedback to create a more complete game.  
We appreciate your interest and participation, and please look forward to the next update!


[h3]Play Now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279910/

Thank you.

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: Next Fest Event End Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!

In this announcement, we would like to inform you about the special skin giveaway event held during the Steam Next Fest period and share our future plans.

We sincerely thank everyone for your participation and interest, and we would also like to share the future direction of the game's development.


[h3]Steam Next Fest Event Results[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/b163b25be5b8682569d09dae2762b4357e1d0434.png[/img]

During the Steam Next Fest in June, all Ascenders who cleared Stage 2 received the 'Chrono Child: White Night' skin! In addition, we promise that a special avatar, usable in the official release version, will be given in the future.

A large number of players participated in the event during Next Fest, and thanks to you, we were able to collect valuable data and a variety of feedback. Once again, we sincerely appreciate your enthusiastic interest and participation in the event.

[list]
[*] Although we manage the event reward recipients separately, to ensure safe delivery, please try to keep the save data you used to participate in the event without deleting it!
[*] The method and specific form of reward distribution will be announced again at the time of the official release.
[*] The special skin will be provided for use in the official release version, and there will be further opportunities to acquire special skins through various events, so please look forward to it!
[*] Some Ascenders may be curious about the official release date; while nothing has been finalized yet, we will share related news as quickly as possible.
[/list]


[h3]Future Game Updates and Plans[/h3]

We deeply appreciate the valuable feedback sent during the Next Fest period, and based on your feedback, we plan to continue with various new attempts and challenges!

The current demo build will serve as the stage for these improvements, and it may go through multiple updates and adjustments, so please look forward to it.

Also, we will continue to introduce more enjoyable and special events, so please stay tuned for more news!



We thank all Ascenders for your continued interest and support, and we will come back to you with good news in the future.

Thank you!

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: Chrono Dispatch - June 20, 2025
notes.content:
[quote][i]『Chrono Dispatch』 has linked to your timeline.[/i][/quote]

Hello, Ascenders!

Welcome to the third [b]Chrono Dispatch[/b].


[h3]◼ Next Fest Has Concluded![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/38657d68d0e40d274f5ec51f2f21090998f61c90.png[/img]

During this Next Fest, more Ascenders than ever joined us in-game!

Thanks to all the valuable reviews you left, we even achieved a recent rating of [b]"Overwhelmingly Positive"[/b]. We sincerely appreciate your support!


Some of our most enthusiastic Ascenders know that we ran a survey to gather your thoughts on future development. That survey gave us a clear picture of which content you want most!

In this Dispatch, we’ll revisit those results and talk about the path ahead.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/2b8ceecd2dd84cb8c134f31a268ee08823002490.png[/img]
First, strengthening the systems for item farming and crafting was the top request! We were thrilled to see it aligns perfectly with the direction we’ve been heading.

Requests for new stages and sustainable content came in second. We’ll keep adding diverse areas and challenges to ensure your adventure never grows stale.

There were also features that received more—or less—interest than expected, which we found intriguing. But fewer votes doesn’t mean an idea gets ignored! Based on your detailed feedback for each item, we’ll be reshuffling our long-term development priorities.

Thank you to all Ascenders who played passionately and took the time to complete the survey.



[h3]◼ Optimization Update News[/h3]

While Next Fest gave us clues about our future roadmap, it also highlighted some performance bottlenecks that were getting in the way of smooth play. Thank you again to everyone who reported issues and shared feedback!

In this update, we’ve resolved various performance bottlenecks across the game so you can enjoy a smoother experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/28f3801711cae60f264e34cdf9ed36af7982125a.png[/img]

[b]◼ Projectile Handling Optimization[/b]  

We’ve partially mitigated the frame drops caused by firing many projectiles at once. 

Previously, you may have noticed major drops when multiple projectile hits triggered simultaneously. Now, we’ve simplified collision detection for high-hit attacks and removed unnecessary updates to reduce the computational load.


[b]◼ Enemy Entity Optimization[/b]  

We’ve also addressed the frame drops that occurred when enemy counts surged after entering Stage 2. 

While we already limited updates to active combatants, performance still lagged when too many enemies appeared. We’ve introduced new logic to drastically lower update frequency, so you’ll see more stable performance even amidst large hordes.


[b]◼ Terrain Collision Optimization[/b]  

We minimized the calculations for interacting with collision objects placed throughout the map. 

In the past, moving around would trigger excessive collision checks; now the overall collision complexity is simplified to reduce the processing burden.


[b]◼ Unnecessary Update Minimization[/b]  

We’ve tightened restrictions on update calls for objects that aren’t visible or affecting gameplay. 

By variably adjusting execution frequency for background object updates, AI logic, and other repeated computations, the CPU can focus on core tasks.



It’s not perfect yet, but you should notice a clear step up in performance!

Next up, we’ll tackle graphics rendering optimizations to eliminate more bottlenecks and improve stability on additional hardware—so stay tuned!



[h3]◼ Keep Journeying With Us![/h3]

Your passion and feedback during Next Fest have been a powerful driving force. We’ll continue listening to every Ascender’s voice and repay you with even more polished updates!

Thank you.


[quote][i]『Chrono Dispatch』 has unlinked from your timeline.[/i][/quote]

notes.title: Demo Update - June 13, 2025
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!

With Next Fest now underway, Ascenders from around the globe have joined us in droves! Thanks to your unprecedented enthusiasm and response, the festival is more vibrant and fun than ever.

Riding this wave of excitement, we have some additional news and updates to share!


[h3]⚪ Participating in the KRAFTON Publisher Sale![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kraftonpublishersale2025] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/323e7a1a2891e2eb628b3f03ce67edf8b8b8c4d6.jpg[/img] [/url]

Ascend to ZERO is featured as a demo in this KRAFTON Publisher Sale event!

Following our appearance on various game streams and at Next Fest, you can now find the Ascend to ZERO demo during the KRAFTON Publisher Sale as well. We’d greatly appreciate your support—please try the demo and leave your valuable feedback to help shape future updates.

More news is on the way, so stay tuned!



[h3]⚪ What’s New in This Update[/h3]

Meanwhile, we’re working hard to quickly address improvements and fixes discovered through playtesting. With this patch, we’re pleased to share that several issues have been resolved:

[list]
[*] Improved handling of enemy attacks that triggered immediately upon time stop release.  
[*] Enhanced visibility of item drop effects.  
[*] Reduced delays on certain actions for a smoother control feel.  
[*] Optimized parts of the inventory UI for better performance.  
[*] Added health value displays to help you predict boss HP more easily.  
[*] Fixed an anomaly that occurred when damage numbers exceeded a certain threshold.  
[*] Corrected an issue where unlock hints for equipment slots sometimes appeared even when conditions weren’t met.  
[*] Improved sound layering to prevent abnormally loud overlapping audio.  
[/list]

[h3]Some Crash Issues & Recommended Workarounds[/h3]

We’ve identified unexpected crashes on certain setups and are investigating root causes. In particular, some [b]graphics driver versions[/b] have shown a potential for conflicts.

If you’re experiencing persistent crashes, we recommend updating your graphics drivers to the latest version—or rolling back to a stable previous version. If the problem persists, please report it in our Steam discussion board or on Discord. We appreciate your reports!



We remain committed to refining your game experience and will continue gathering your feedback to make Ascend to ZERO shine even brighter.

Enjoy the events and content we’ve prepared, and thank you for staying with us throughout the festival!


[h3]Play Now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279910/

Thank you!

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: Special Voice Actor Update! – June 11, 2025 Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!  
As we teased last time, we can finally reveal our special guest!  

It’s [b]Akari Kito[/b] joining the world of Ascend to ZERO.  


[h3]⚪ Hear the Voice of Akari Kito![/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/e502bfc95e0cca5c585080f5b2f01e0d62e9cd09.png[/img]  

Akari Kito delivers captivating Japanese CV performances for six different avatars. Experience each character’s unique emotions brought to life through her delicate acting!  

Plus, brand-new [b]exclusive voices[/b] for the Next Fest special avatar skin have also been recorded. Immerse yourself even deeper with this voice package prepared exclusively for the festival!  

Play now to check out the new Japanese voice content that comes with the limited-time skin.  


[h3]⚪ Additional Update Details[/h3]  

Beyond the voice update, this patch also includes bug fixes and various improvements.  

[list]  
[*] Fixed an issue where some effects appeared to play while time was stopped.  
[*] Adjusted the UI update cycle to improve performance.  
[*] Corrected abnormal DPS readings when the value exceeded certain thresholds.  
[*] Improved visibility of the stamina UI display.  
[*] Fixed an issue where items were difficult to pick up in certain high-drop scenarios.  
[*] Addressed a bug where acquired skill chips would sometimes disappear unexpectedly.  
[*] Fixed abnormal skill chip activations during time stop.  
[*] Resolved an issue where some summoned boss minions would continuously respawn.

[*] Aligned weapon-application UI displays for skill chip effects to match actual weapon effects.

[/list]  


[h3]⚪ The Next Fest Heat Is On![/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/38657d68d0e40d274f5ec51f2f21090998f61c90.png[/img]  

Thanks to your enthusiastic play and valuable feedback, the Next Fest is shining brighter than ever.  

Look forward to upcoming new content and special events!  

If you haven’t grabbed the Next Fest exclusive [b]avatar skin[/b] yet, don’t miss your chance!  

We sincerely thank all Ascenders who continue to enjoy Ascend to ZERO. We hope you’ll join us for the adventures ahead!  


[h3]Play Now![/h3]  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279910/  

Thank you!  

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: New Stage! – June 6, 2025 Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!

In this update, massive new stage content is being added!

The detailed contents being added with the June 6 update are as follows.


[h3]⚪ New Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] A new stage, the Desert Zone, is being added! After defeating the final boss of the existing stages, a portal to the next stage will open, where you can face even more powerful enemies and obtain rare rewards.
[*] Build Tech Chips are being added to the 4th and 5th avatars as well, so now you can enjoy new Tech Chip builds on every avatar.
[*] An item enhancement system is being added, which will be unlocked during Stage 2 play.
[*] A total of 30 Steam Achievements are being added.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ Balance Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The attack power of avatar skills has been adjusted overall to improve performance gaps between avatars.
[*] Excessive penalty values assigned to certain Tech Chips have been adjusted.
[*] The drop rates in the post-game draw have been adjusted so that more powerful items can appear.
[*] Some equipment related to Tech Chip rerolls has been removed, and now disassembling them will convert them into twice the amount of Zero Cells.
[*] Fixed the issue where, when paralysis probability was high, enemies could be paralyzed continuously in an unintended way.
[*] The starting level values among stage entry stats have been increased.
[*] The stats of certain overpowered gadgets have been lowered.
[*] Some patterns of bosses that were difficult to dodge have been improved.
[*] The accumulated time penalty from death has been eased to alleviate unreasonable difficulty in later stages.
[*] The values of cubes that increase time have been increased.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some UI buttons in the inventory were not working.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain weapon attacks would last excessively long.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where the game would crash during the tutorial.
[*] Corrected incorrect damage display for some avatars’ Hyper Skills.
[*] Fixed an issue where some colors were displayed incorrectly in the stage entry UI.
[*] Fixed an issue where a bright lighting effect briefly appeared on screen when starting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where in some areas players could move outside the combat zone.
[*] Fixed an occasional issue in Hard Mode where items would not drop properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips in the compendium were not displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where dash distance varied depending on frame rate.
[*] Fixed an issue where collected rewards were not being saved properly.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] In the stage entry UI, stat displays have been improved to make maximum values more intuitive.
[*] Elite and boss enemy icons now disappear immediately when they die.
[*] Drone tracking logic has been improved for better usability.
[/list]


[h3]⚪ Other Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Avatar-specific dash effects have been improved to display correctly.
[*] The first screen after starting the game has been remastered.
[*] Effects for higher-rank Tech Chips have been added to enhance the impact of powerful Tech Chips.
[*] Sound effects for tutorial progression and for repairing the Time Machine have been added.
[/list]


[h3]Play Now![/h3]
store.steampowered.com/app/3279910

Thank you.

- Ascend to ZERO Team

notes.title: Chrono Dispatch - May 23, 2025
notes.content:
[quote][i]『Chrono Dispatch』 has linked to your timeline.[/i][/quote]

Hello, Ascenders!

Welcome to the first [b]Chrono Dispatch[/b]!

Chrono Dispatch is your friendly, bite-sized source for all things Ascend to ZERO development. We’ll drop by with news whenever there’s an important update or exciting behind-the-scenes peek.

In this edition, we’ve got a sneak preview of the next update, plus a rundown of upcoming events!


[h3]◼ Content Update Preview[/h3]

We’re putting the finishing touches on a major content update for [b]Stage Two[/b]!

In the early stages, we focused on strategic depth through the time-stop system, and we’re thrilled by the positive feedback so far.

notes.title: Developer Note – May 9, 2025
notes.content:
Hello, Ascenders!

[b]Ascend to ZERO[/b] demo has received a tremendous amount of interest and support, and we sincerely thank you.

During our ongoing small patches, the development team has engaged in extensive discussions based on your valuable feedback and play data. While deeply considering the core fun and areas for improvement in the current A2Z, we’ve also organized ideas for our future direction.

In this post, we’d like to share the experiences that our team has personally identified as needing improvement, along with our planned short-term actions and long-term vision.


[h3]Revamping the Item System to Bring Back the Thrill of Farming[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/e8a751d21575c5c70143924f2f59e5fb1685430f.png[/img]

The mid-to-late-game progression of Ascend to ZERO begins with farming.

Since the prototype stage, the synergy between farming rewards and progression has provided the core fun and motivation of A2Z, and we wanted to convey this experience more deeply and clearly.

However, as we’ve focused on harmonizing content, the thrill of farming has become somewhat blurred. To address this, we are preparing the following directions:


[b]Visualizing Powerful Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] We recognized that the strength of items wasn’t immediately apparent, and players lacked a tangible sense of impact when using them.
[*] Moving forward, we will enhance visual presentations and effects so that the feeling of “I have to get this” becomes more pronounced.
[/list]
[b]Expanding Diverse Farming Routes[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve noticed that certain rare items only appeared under specific conditions, making them hard to access.
[*] We plan to expand [b]diverse routes[/b] for obtaining [b]valuable items[/b].
[/list]
[b]Introducing an Item Enhancement System[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve felt disappointed that, despite attachment to favorite items, there was no way to further upgrade them.
[*] We’re preparing a system that enables post-farming “follow-up progression,” such as stat modifications and enhancements.
[/list]


[h3]Strengthening Build Identity and Strategic Depth[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/d01d8391f43fbbb77f2aad02a7d68a1461608a4f.png[/img]

Since the recent introduction of a simple character build system, many of you have commented positively that the gameplay experience feels fresh.

However, we feel there is still room to expand the experience of building builds and the distinctiveness and depth of resulting playstyles in various ways.

Therefore, we plan to strengthen the build system in the following ways:
[list]
[*] We’ll add [b]Tech Chips that clearly distinguish playstyles[/b], allowing you to experiment with build variations each run.
[*] We’re also preparing [b]powerful Tech Chips with accompanying risks[/b]. We aim to deliver both the tension of choice and the thrill of reward that amplify the roguelike fun.
[/list]


[h3]Balancing Melee vs Ranged Combat[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/ca13e980c759e19e39c08fdc6c65bcde3f8ed997.png[/img]

Through multiple tests and data analysis, we confirmed that [b]the risk-reward of melee combat is currently insufficient[/b].

While it bears more burden in pattern evasion and positioning, its rewards haven’t been sufficient.

Rather than simply tweaking numbers, we intend to improve this by ensuring that the risk-reward for character build specialization is clear in the following ways:
[list]
[*] We’ll introduce [b]dedicated Tech Chips and patterns that empower melee builds[/b], and rebalance monster placements and patterns to reduce unfair play experiences.
[*] We’ll avoid structures where melee build advantages also benefit ranged builds, adjusting so that each combat style’s identity and role naturally stand out.
[/list]


[h3]Ongoing Language Support[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/c3051fa325017ec92e2017ebc6846c336a2368ba.png[/img]

With the hope that A2Z reaches Ascenders around the world, we will be adding ongoing language support. We’re also pleased to announce that the [b]French[/b] beta version has been added in today’s update!

Please try it out and let us know via the community if anything seems off.



[h3]Thank You for Your Feedback![/h3]

Since the demo’s release, Ascend to ZERO has greatly benefited from your reviews and feedback in shaping our optimization and content improvement directions.

To repay your gameplay experiences, the development team is preparing an exciting update aiming for [b]June’s Steam Next Fest[/b].



We thank all Ascenders playing Ascend to ZERO, and we’ll greet you in the next Developer Note!

[b]- Ascend to ZERO Team[/b]

notes.title: Update on Game Balance and Item Changes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Ascenders![/h3]
Are you enjoying the demo version of Ascend to ZERO?

Thanks to your incredible support, our development team is more motivated than ever to create even more content for the game.

We've received a wide range of feedback regarding game balance and content volume, and we’re doing our best to make improvements based on your valuable input.

In this announcement, we’d like to share the current power balance status and our future response plan.



[h2]On Balance After Clearing Stage 1[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/1cd7415550b53b94425d958f328e76f766e3575c.png[/img]

To ensure that players still have opportunities to grow after completing the first stage, we implemented the Horde Berserk mechanic.

However, this system led to a sharp inflation in growth speed, and some players noted that the repetitiveness made gameplay feel tedious over time.

Taking upcoming content into consideration, we are currently working on balancing this mechanic. In future updates, we aim to introduce more engaging growth systems rather than simple inflation-based progression—so please stay tuned for exciting new patches!



[h2]Development Direction & Plans for Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/25fe7283a452e2e233edcbb87dab7b669b2e0c42.png[/img]

We believe that item farming is essential for long-term enjoyment and progression in Ascend to ZERO, and we're working on improving the systems to make farming more rewarding and fun.

The upcoming patch will introduce new content updates along with a core game system that marks the beginning of unique item farming!



However, during the planning of future content, we discovered that some of the demo-exclusive items were significantly more powerful than expected.

To elaborate, we had intentionally hidden some powerful items in the demo to reduce monotony during repeated playthroughs and to allow players to preview growth mechanics.

That said, we've concluded that these items allow for growth beyond intended limits through repeated looting, which could negatively affect the balance and enjoyment of upcoming farming content.

As a result, the following items will be removed in the next content patch:

[list]
[*] SW Overclock
[*] SW Mind Tool
[*] Brain Bolt
[*] Cutting Gene
[*] Toxic Gene
[*] Overheat Gene
[*] Paralysis Gene
[*] Multidimensional Enhancer
[*] Multidimensional Nano Shield
[*] Multidimensional Core
[/list]
These items will be automatically converted into currency equal to 2 times their dismantling cost.
We sincerely apologize for the unexpected inconvenience and promise to be more careful to prevent such incidents from happening again in the future.


[h2]We Want Your Feedback![/h2]
One of the most valuable aspects of a demo is being able to shape the game together with you—our Ascenders.

Please continue to share your thoughts and feedback on the game's direction through our Steam Community, Discord channel, or player surveys.


store.steampowered.com/app/3279910

We’ll be back soon with an exciting new patch!

Thank you for your continued support!

– Ascend to ZERO Team

[*] Warning indicators have been added to some attacks of the Lv.10800 and Lv.12100 monsters, which previously did not have any warnings.
[*] The health of the Lv.20000 Boss monster has been increased.
[*] The required currency amounts for unlocking avatars and gadgets have been adjusted.
[/list]

[h3]⚪ Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Pluripotent-Cell item has been changed to a currency and can now be viewed in the HUD. 
[*] During tech chip selection, current stats can now be checked.
[*] An indicator has been added to display the type of items.
[*] The location of the Skip button during dialogue and cutscene sequences has been improved.
[/list]

[h3]⚪ Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list] 
[*] An issue where the UI sound would not play on some pads has been fixed.
[*] A bug that allowed tech chips to be re-selected in certain situations has been fixed.
[*] An issue where monsters continued to spawn while the feedback and settings windows were open has been fixed.
[/list]

[h3]⚪ Art & Visual Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Background VFX has been improved to be consistently affected by time stop.
[*] The visibility of the monster's rush effect has been improved.
[*] The visibility of VFX when using some gadget skills has been improved.
[*] The visibility of effects when characters are hit has been improved.
[/list]

[h3]⚪ Performance Optimization[/h3]
[list] 
[*] An issue where game performance gradually degraded over time has been improved.
[*] Performance issues during battles with many monsters on the field have been improved.
[*] Support for Nvidia DLSS 4 and FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 has been added. Upscaling is automatically applied depending on the device, and detailed settings will be supported in a future patch.
[/list]


[h3]Play Now![/h3]
store.steampowered.com/app/3279910

Thank you!

[b]- Ascend to ZERO Team[/b]

notes.title: Development Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191793/432340d72107f7ed851e780aea65bb0e79c99c3b.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

The development team has been working hard, and we are excited to announce that our project has now entered the [b]QA (Quality Assurance)[/b] phase. This QA process will run for about a week, allowing us to thoroughly test and refine the game’s stability and quality.

Thank you.
